text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After her latest race, Symboli Rudolf<n>shows up at
my office while I'm<n>working.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There's something I'd like to discuss<n>with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe it's vital for Umamusume<n>and their trainers
to respect one<n>another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If they are to tread the same path,<n>they must walk
in stride.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, I will be frank with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My current racing schedule is too<n>intense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't put my best foot forward in<n>future races if
I'm still exhausted<n>from past ones.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The final decision is yours, but I<n>would appreciate it
if you would take<n>my opinion into consideration.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has a point. We might<n>need to revise
our current approach.
